owner.introducedAsEvidence: It is the fourth gate. Sufficiency and indeterminacy are already excluded above it, and the only outcome below it is NOT_PERSISTENT, so the sole effect of the gate is to withhold a NOT_PERSISTENT answer that the head was otherwise about to give.

conflictOwner.gateKindEvidence: Every path reaching it has already cleared the sufficiency gate; the only alternative outcome below it is NOT_PERSISTENT.

cases.rationale: A complete window that alternates every step carries abundant evidence that nothing is sustained.
One bounded interruption is exactly what the contract tolerates.
The tendency was real and was not sustained to the end of the window.
Direction turns repeatedly inside a complete window.
Bounded zero-mean variation with no net travel.
Local wobble far smaller than the step; every step still advances.
Net drift exists but no direction is SUSTAINED at step level: the wobble is five times the slope, so the series reverses every step. Under V1 this is a finding, not a gap.

Coverage falls below the V1 minimum of 0.8, so no finding about the process is available. This is the case the brief warns about and it is the only conflict-shaped category that legitimately keeps its abstention.
Every frame observed and the series reverses every step while drifting slowly upward. The conflict is a property of the process, not of the observation.

conflictSemantics.separationRule: historyCoverage === 1 -> genuine conflict (NOT_PERSISTENT); historyCoverage < 1 -> apparent conflict (INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE)

conflictReachability.shadowingExplanation: directionalConsistency is max(dominant, other)/nonzero and so is never below 0.5. The gate needs it under 0.62, i.e. near-balanced step signs — and a near-balanced series almost always has |slope| < .003, which the INDETERMINATE_DIRECTION gate above it catches first. Gate two shadows gate four across nearly the whole input space.
conflictReachability.reachableOnlyWhen: Step signs are near-balanced AND the full-window slope still clears 0.003 — a few large steps in one direction against many small opposing ones.

remediationRationale.note: The structural argument stands: the gate sits after sufficiency and immediately before NOT_PERSISTENT, so it can only withhold an answer the head was about to give. But it fires on no case of any real corpus and on none of a wide deterministic sweep, so there is nothing to repair and no way to demonstrate a repair worked. Recorded as a documentation-level defect in the frozen head, owned and not patched.

sustainedRunAudit.note: Every verdict is computed from the produced series against STAGE2L21_PERSISTENCE_SEMANTICS_V1. The generator's intent is recorded but carries no weight.

phaseMap.note: The generator sweeps slope 0.004-0.028 against jitter 0-0.024, so its operating box straddles the boundary rather than sitting inside the persistent region.

tradeoff.note: Retention is measured against cases that genuinely require an abstention, so a zero here is a result rather than an artefact.

interpretation.sustainedRunCurrentStatus: PARTIALLY_MISLABELLED: 18 of 120 cases labelled PERSISTENT do not depict a sustained run once the generator's jitter is applied.
interpretation.corpusRegenerationNote: The brief instructs that a defective corpus be diagnosed and owned rather than silently regenerated in the same run. The defect does not prevent the semantic analysis, which is adjudicated from the series independently of any label, so regeneration is deferred.
